Grocery List Generator

Generate a grocery shopping list scaled to people, days and meals — with quantities, categories and your own custom items.

–
Items
–
Est. produce (kg)

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the number of people and days, and tick the meals you cook.
  2. Pick a diet preference to filter the items.
  3. Generate the list, add custom items, then download or copy it for shopping.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are quantities calculated?

Staple quantities are computed per person per day (e.g. ~0.5 kg vegetables daily) and rounded to sensible shopping units.

Can I add my own items?

Yes — add any item with your own quantity in the custom section and it appears in the list and download.

What if I skip a meal?

Uncheck any meal type and its ingredients are excluded from the generated list.

Is this private?

Everything runs locally in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
